svg.text: The quote environment is useful for quotes, important phrases and examples.
A typographical rule of thumb for the line length is:
On average, no line should be longer than 66 characters.
There are two similar environments: the quotation and the verse environ-
ments. The quotation environment is useful for longer quotes going over sev-
eral paragraphs, because it indents the first line of each paragraph. The verse
environment is useful for poems where the line breaks are important. The lines
are separated by issuing a \\ at the end of a line and an empty line after each
Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall:
Humpty Dumpty had a great fall.
All the King’s horses and all the King’s men
Couldn’t put Humpty together again. —J.W. Elliott
